mapper.sql:
FROM yc_shop_product p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_on_shelf = 1
AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND ( LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_code, '')) LIKE '%glb%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_code, '')) LIKE '%3d%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.name, '')) LIKE '%glb%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.name, '')) LIKE '%3d%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.subtitle, '')) LIKE '%glb%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.subtitle, '')) LIKE '%3d%' OR COALESCE(p.subtitle, '') LIKE '%模型%' OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%模型%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%modelUrl:%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%modelUrl：%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%fullModelUrl:%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%fullModelUrl：%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%glbUrl:%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%glbUrl：%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%模型地址:%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%模型地址：%' )
AND NOT ( LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_code, '')) LIKE '%glb%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_code, '')) LIKE '%3d%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.name, '')) LIKE '%glb%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.name, '')) LIKE '%3d%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.subtitle, '')) LIKE '%glb%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.subtitle, '')) LIKE '%3d%' OR COALESCE(p.subtitle, '') LIKE '%模型%' OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%模型%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%modelUrl:%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%modelUrl：%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%fullModelUrl:%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%fullModelUrl：%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%glbUrl:%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%glbUrl：%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%模型地址:%' OR COALESCE(p.detail_content, '') LIKE '%模型地址：%' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1)

SELECT p.id, p.product_code, p.name, p.subtitle, p.cover_url, p.detail_content, p.price, p.stock, p.sold_count, p.is_on_shelf, p.status, p.sort_no, p.created_by, p.updated_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at
ORDER BY p.sort_no DESC, p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id, p.product_code, p.name, p.subtitle, p.cover_url, p.detail_content, p.price, p.stock, p.sold_count, p.is_on_shelf, p.status, p.sort_no, p.created_by, p.updated_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at FROM yc_shop_product p WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_on_shelf = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.product_code, p.name, p.subtitle, p.cover_url, p.detail_content, p.price, p.stock, p.sold_count, p.is_on_shelf, p.status, p.sort_no, p.created_by, p.updated_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at FROM yc_shop_product p WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.product_code, p.name, p.subtitle, p.cover_url, p.detail_content, p.price, p.stock, p.sold_count, p.is_on_shelf, p.status, p.sort_no, p.created_by, p.updated_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at FROM yc_shop_product p WHERE p.product_code = #{productCode} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yc_shop_product (product_code, name, subtitle, cover_url, detail_content, price, stock, sold_count, is_on_shelf, status, sort_no, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{productCode}, #{name}, #{subtitle}, #{coverUrl}, #{detailContent}, #{price}, #{stock}, 0, #{isOnShelf}, #{status}, #{sortNo}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE yc_shop_product SET product_code = #{productCode}, name = #{name}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, detail_content = #{detailContent}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, is_on_shelf = #{isOnShelf}, status = #{status}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE yc_shop_product SET is_on_shelf = #{isOnShelf}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE yc_shop_product SET status = 0, is_on_shelf = 0, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW(), deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE yc_shop_product SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 1 AND is_on_shelf = 1 AND stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE yc_shop_product SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE yc_shop_product SET sold_count = sold_count + #{quantity}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, c.created_at, c.updated_at, p.product_code, p.name AS product_name, p.subtitle AS product_subtitle, p.cover_url, p.price, p.stock, p.is_on_shelf, p.status FROM yc_shop_cart_item c INNER JOIN yc_shop_product p ON p.id = c.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yc_shop_cart_item (user_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity})
mapper.update: UPDATE yc_shop_cart_item SET quantity = #{quantity}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, c.created_at, c.updated_at, p.product_code, p.name AS product_name, p.subtitle AS product_subtitle, p.cover_url, p.price, p.stock, p.is_on_shelf, p.status FROM yc_shop_cart_item c INNER JOIN yc_shop_product p ON p.id = c.product_id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, c.created_at, c.updated_at, p.product_code, p.name AS product_name, p.subtitle AS product_subtitle, p.cover_url, p.price, p.stock, p.is_on_shelf, p.status FROM yc_shop_cart_item c INNER JOIN yc_shop_product p ON p.id = c.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yc_shop_order (order_no, user_id, total_amount, total_quantity, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, buyer_remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{totalQuantity}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{buyerRemark})

INSERT INTO yc_shop_order_item (order_id, product_id, product_code, product_name, product_subtitle, product_cover_url, unit_price, quantity, subtotal_amount) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{productSubtitle}, #{productCoverUrl}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity}, #{subtotalAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, o.total_amount, o.total_quantity, o.status, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, o.buyer_remark, o.payment_marked_at, o.payment_reviewed_at, o.payment_review_by, rv.display_name AS payment_review_by_name, o.payment_review_remark, o.shipped_at, o.shipped_by, sv.display_name AS shipped_by_name, o.shipping_company, o.tracking_no, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM yc_shop_order o LEFT JOIN yc_user_account u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN yc_user_account rv ON rv.id = o.payment_review_by LEFT JOIN yc_user_account sv ON sv.id = o.shipped_by WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, o.total_amount, o.total_quantity, o.status, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, o.buyer_remark, o.payment_marked_at, o.payment_reviewed_at, o.payment_review_by, rv.display_name AS payment_review_by_name, o.payment_review_remark, o.shipped_at, o.shipped_by, sv.display_name AS shipped_by_name, o.shipping_company, o.tracking_no, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM yc_shop_order o LEFT JOIN yc_user_account u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN yc_user_account rv ON rv.id = o.payment_review_by LEFT JOIN yc_user_account sv ON sv.id = o.shipped_by WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, o.total_amount, o.total_quantity, o.status, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, o.buyer_remark, o.payment_marked_at, o.payment_reviewed_at, o.payment_review_by, rv.display_name AS payment_review_by_name, o.payment_review_remark, o.shipped_at, o.shipped_by, sv.display_name AS shipped_by_name, o.shipping_company, o.tracking_no, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM yc_shop_order o LEFT JOIN yc_user_account u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN yc_user_account rv ON rv.id = o.payment_review_by LEFT JOIN yc_user_account sv ON sv.id = o.shipped_by WHERE o.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT oi.id, oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.product_code, oi.product_name, oi.product_subtitle, oi.product_cover_url, oi.unit_price, oi.quantity, oi.subtotal_amount, oi.created_at FROM yc_shop_order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.id ASC

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, o.total_amount, o.total_quantity, o.status, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, o.buyer_remark, o.payment_marked_at, o.payment_reviewed_at, o.payment_review_by, rv.display_name AS payment_review_by_name, o.payment_review_remark, o.shipped_at, o.shipped_by, sv.display_name AS shipped_by_name, o.shipping_company, o.tracking_no, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM yc_shop_order o LEFT JOIN yc_user_account u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN yc_user_account rv ON rv.id = o.payment_review_by LEFT JOIN yc_user_account sv ON sv.id = o.shipped_by WHERE o.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND o.created_at <= #{cutoff} ORDER BY o.created_at ASC, o.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE yc_shop_order SET status = 'PENDING_REVIEW', payment_marked_at = #{paymentMarkedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'

UPDATE yc_shop_order SET status = #{toStatus}, payment_reviewed_at = #{paymentReviewedAt}, payment_review_by = #{paymentReviewBy}, payment_review_remark = #{paymentReviewRemark}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE yc_shop_order SET status = #{toStatus}, shipped_at = #{shippedAt}, shipped_by = #{shippedBy}, shipping_company = #{shippingCompany}, tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
